name: cloud-simulation-demo
description: Cloud Simulation Demo using LocalStack, Serverless, and React

scripts.backend:deploy: cd backend && npx serverless deploy --stage local
scripts.setup: npm run infra:up && npm run infra:wait && npm run backend:deploy
scripts.demo: concurrently "npm run infra:up" "npm run infra:wait && npm run backend:deploy" "npm run frontend:start"
